title: Finding a sound backdrop that is comfortable
description: Compare several sounds and save the backdrop that suits you personally, ready to start again.

blocks.text: People hear one and the same backdrop differently. A complaint about promised tinnitus masking shows the limit of a product like this: a catalog of sounds must not be presented as a treatment.

quote.text: Another false claim about drowning out tinnitus…didn’t do a thing for me

blocks.text: Make it easy to compare several tracks at a chosen volume and to save personal preferences. The outcome of the choice is a familiar sound the person wants to come back to.

The first thing to find out is whether an ordinary player with favorites already solves this. Extra settings are there for a noticeable gain in convenience when choosing, not for a pseudo-medical promise to find the “right frequency”.
